description: This file defines the 'Report' controller class within the Opencart admin extension system, responsible for managing report extensions including listing, installation, and uninstallation of report modules.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Controller class for managing report extensions in the OpenCart admin interface, including listing, installing, and uninstalling report modules.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the list of available report extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates and returns the list of report extensions with their statuses and actions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a report extension and sets necessary permissions and autoloaders.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Uninstalls a report extension and triggers related cleanup actions.
